name: MENTAT
description: A testbed for evaluating nonlinear filtering algorithms across simulated and/or measured sensor scenarios.
general_score_metric: RMSE (root mean squared error) / estimation error
reputation: A niche, domain-specific testbed cited within the nonlinear filtering/control research community but not widely used outside that field.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark based on simulated and/or measured sensor scenarios; results are scenario- and model-dependent. Small/controlled scenarios and attacker/noise characteristics can limit generalization; not standardized for language-model evaluation.
